description: Place a simple perp order on HyperLiquid without TP/SL. isMarket=true (default) is sent via /hl/create_order as a market order; isMarket=false sends a limit order at `price` via /hl/place_order, which the backend currently accepts only with reduceOnly=true.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

apiKey.description: GDEX API key for AES encryption

isLong.description: True for long, false for short

isMarket.description: True for market (via create_order), false for limit

price.description: Price in USD ('0' with isMarket=true uses the mark price)

name: place_perp_order
